date_note: The page says the site has been offline since Friday (20); it gives no earlier day.
exec: The Alagoas state government's main website has been offline since Friday after what Cadaminuto reports as a hacker attack.
geo_basis: state government (Alagoas, Brazil); city not stated in the source
plain: The Alagoas state government's website has been down since Friday because of a hacker attack, according to a local news site. The state tech institute says a new site is due on Monday and will not give details while police investigate.
summary: Cadaminuto reports that the Alagoas state government website, alagoas.al.gov.br, has been offline since Friday because of a hacker attack. Itec, the state's technology institute, says a new platform is expected on Monday, with the earlier content being recovered. Itec says the case is being investigated by the state public security department's intelligence unit, so details cannot be disclosed.
title: Alagoas state government website offline since Friday after hacker attack, local news reports

validation.note: Only Cadaminuto's page was read; it quotes Itec's official reply. No page from the Alagoas government or Itec itself was read.

review.note: stronger than the source: content 'recovered' now 'being recovered' per Cadaminuto; date, Itec statement, investigation match
